policy.summary: Chrome uses real LeafyGreen components for fidelity. The canvas itself is open to any library — same palette, typography, easing curves, and spatial rhythm. Talks LG, walks LG, even if the canvas internals are an R3F scene.

chrome.rationale: Fidelity for the parts users interact with directly. Top bar, controls, drawers, callouts, copy chips, badges, typography — these are where users learn the design language; they should be unmistakably LeafyGreen.

canvas.rationale: Don't cage rendering work just because of design system. The canvas is where new things happen; align on look-and-feel, not on toolkit.
constraints: typography: Euclid Circular A (or stack fallback)
